content.comment_body: We have connected the [product_name] module to the [article_no] base module, and wired a 4-wire PT100 sensor to the [product_name] module as follows: M1+ (red wire), IC1 (red wire), M1- (white wire), and the last white wire left open. In the [product_name] software, we tried using the configuration from the file in [url], but regardless of what we do, we only receive a value of -50 from AI1. I suspect this might be because we are using the [product_name] module as input, but the AI1..8 inputs are only on the [article_no] base module. How do we specify that the inputs should be read from the [product_name] module?

AI1 and AI2 are located on the [product_name] base module. AI3 and subsequent inputs are the first analog inputs on the [product_name] expansion module, continuing onward. In some cases, you might use AI3 and AI4 on the [product_name] base module, but if your module is [article_no], then you should use AI5 and following inputs.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing challenges configuring the [product_name] sensor module with the [article_no] base module, particularly with identifying and reading analog inputs from the attached expansion, not the main unit. Confusion over correct input assignment in the software leads to consistently incorrect sensor readings. The discussion demonstrates a lack of clear guidance for module integration and setup.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] software to automatically or clearly support correct mapping and reading of analog inputs from the [product_name] expansion module.
